data.bottom_line: You are most likely to encounter unstable snow where wind has built drifts and slabs, particularly where they sit on older snow from October. Pay attention to the snowpack as you travel through the mountains—cracking and collapsing are clear indicators of instability. You can greatly reduce your avalanche risk by avoiding steep slopes above about 9,500' where wind has hardened the snowpack. We will update this General Avalanche Information product as more snow accumulates.
